Throttle

Stopped at a light? Hold REV (or the R key) and it barks. Let go and the revs fall back to idle, crackling on the way down.

Best over your car's speakers: pair your phone over Bluetooth, or open this page in your EV's built-in browser. Keep your eyes on the road, not the tach.

Pick your engine

Six synthesized engines, built pulse by pulse from firing order, cylinder count and redline - no recordings, every sound is generated live. Swap engines mid-drive, it retunes on the fly.

How it works

1. Speed in

In GPS mode the page reads your phone's GPS speed about once a second, the same trick the in-car version uses. In pedal mode, a simple physics model does the driving instead.

2. Gears & revs

Speed runs through each car's own gear set - 6, 7, even a 3-speed in the hearse - and a shift model like a real car: gentle throttle shifts early, a floored pedal runs to the redline, flooring it from a cruise kicks down a gear or two, every shift cuts torque while the revs sweep, and downshifts blip to rev-match. Lifting off at high rpm sets off exhaust pops and crackle. Switch the gearbox at the top of the page to Manual and the gears only move when you move them - tap the big zones on the screen edges to shift while driving (right side up, left side down), and a red arrow beside the gear number tells you when it's time to shift up. Parked, the car's scroll wheel reaches the page too: scroll to shift, hold the wheel button to rev.

3. Sound out

There is no continuous engine tone. Every cylinder firing drops one pressure pulse into its bank's pipe model - a smooth Hann-windowed pressure bump mixed with a short burst of combustion noise, the pulse model teslasound.io's own synth uses - so a crossplane V8's uneven bank spacing (180-270-180-90 deg) comes out as a genuine burble, not an even hum. The pipes feed a formant bank, then a muffler that sweeps open as revs and throttle rise. Lift off with a hot exhaust and discrete afterfire pops - each one a small explosion in the same pipes - arrive in ragged bursts between misfiring burbles, and holding REV on the limiter drops the firings to air-pumping thumps with cracks in the exhaust. Nothing is a recording.

Location is used only to measure speed in GPS mode and never leaves your browser. Expect a beat of lag in GPS mode - phone GPS refreshes about once a second. build 2026-10-22 18:24 PDT
